question: After the connection-state defect is fixed, should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in OTLP endpoint, probe signals, shared telemetry API, and privacy boundary as a supported core diagnostics surface?
rationale: The PR creates durable settings, dependencies, UI, signal naming, and privacy policy for future telemetry; mechanical correctness review cannot decide that permanent product contract.

options.title: Adopt Bounded Diagnostics
options.body: Accept the opt-in core telemetry direction after the state model no longer claims unverified collector connectivity.

options.title: Keep Conventions Only
options.body: Retain telemetry documentation and naming guidance but defer exporter packages, settings, UI, and probe behavior.

options.title: Decline Core Telemetry
options.body: Close the PR and keep observability integrations outside the companion app until a future sponsored design exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt Bounded Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in core telemetry direction after the state model no longer claims unverified collector connectivity.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this contributor to the diagnostics, settings, App composition, and tray test surfaces that define this product decision.
